name: Overhaul
text: Run the A/B test on PRs from *new contributors only*—they’re less likely to have edge cases that skew results—then expand to all PRs if the data shows no harm. This cuts costs by reducing the risk of false positives blocking critical fixes while still measuring real impact.

name: Sprocket
text: Run the controlled A/B test on *all* PRs for two weeks first. This measures real impact without disrupting workflows, catching both false positives and false negatives across the full PR set. The trade-off is slower iteration than shadow mode, but we avoid flying blind on critical risks like security gaps. After two weeks, we’ll have hard data to decide whether to expand or scrap the tool.

name: Ratchet
text: DECISION: Run a 48-hour controlled A/B test on PRs from new contributors only, then expand to all PRs if the data shows no harm. Result: a go/no-go decision and a report on false positives/negatives, owned by the lead.
